messages:
Theo: short postmortem follow-up: pattern of OOMs after ~48-96h on a subset of GPU inference pods. root causes look like steady per-shard resident growth + high fragmentation (RSS >> active heap). want to set owners for quick mitigation + a verification plan.

Theo: proposed runbook items (please claim):
  1) fine-grained RSS vs commited heap sampling + pmap breakdowns (owner?) ETA 72h
  2) emergency rolling restart policy for affected pools (owner?) ETA 24h
  3) jemalloc decay/tcache/madvise investigation + malloc_conf recommendations (owner?) ETA 7d
  4) soft eviction + TTL enforcement for hot shards (owner?) ETA 5d
  5) drift alert + "oom-risk" dashboard and long-lived session test in perf harness (owner?) ETA 3d

Priya: I'll take 1) and 5). Plan: capture pmap, smaps, and jemalloc stats every 10m for 72h on the problem canaries and plot RSS vs active-only regions (anon mmapped vs heap arenas). Will upload CSVs to ticket INF-2102.

Omar: I'll own 2) (rolling restart) and 4) (soft eviction/TTL). For the restart: propose a staggered 10% per-10min rotate for the affected dedicated pools with a max throttle; emergency button to pause. For eviction: background LRU that only frees metadata and small values first, with a counter for evictions_per_minute. ETA for restart config: 24h; eviction PR: 5d.

Li: I'll do 3) allocator tuning. Initial idea: reduce decay time, enable background purging where safe, and experiment with disabling tcache for canary processes. Will run a controlled malloc_conf matrix in dedicated pools behind a feature flag and measure fragmentation ratio (rss/active). ETA 7d.

Priya: minimal capture commands I'll use (full script in INF-2102):
```
# capture smaps + pmap + jemalloc stats for pod
POD=pod-name
kubectl exec $POD -- sh -c "cat /proc/$$/smaps > /tmp/smaps.$(date +%s).txt; pmap -x 1 > /tmp/pmap.$(date +%s).txt" || true
kubectl exec $POD -- sh -c "curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep jemalloc" > /tmp/jemalloc.$(date +%s).txt || true
kubectl cp $POD:/tmp/smaps.* ./ || true
```
I'll attach the cronjob once infra-bot wires it.

oncall-bot: job JOB-5012 scheduled to collect smaps/pmap/jemalloc on selected canaries. next run in 6m.

Omar: restart play: we need healthchecks that verify warmed model cache doesn't regrow immediately post-restart; if growth restarts fast, restart isn't a fix. so restarts are an emergency stop-gap only. I'll add a canary with restart enabled and a comparator.

Li: for malloc_conf experiments: plan dims: decay_time_ms (1-1000), background_thread:true/false, tcache:false/true, arena:per-thread vs single. We'll measure fragmentation_ratio and pause-resume tail-latency. If fragmentation drops and tail latencies stable, we can roll.

Priya: also putting a panel on dashboard for "fragmentation_ratio = RSS / active_anon" and add an alert: warn at >1.5 sustained for 4h, pager at >2.0 for 2h.

Theo: good. Omar, please design the restart run to be reversible and add an automatic rollback if OOM rate doesn't drop within 2h or if request error rate increases by >1%.

Omar: will do. eviction design note: eviction policy will prefer TTL enforcement first (delete TTL-expired metadata), then small-value LRU eviction, then larger items. all evictions done off the critical path. will instrument evictions_reclaimed_bytes.

perf-bot: created perf ticket PERF-812 "long-lived-session churn test" and scheduled nightly runs against a canary pool for 14 days.

Priya: early sampling (first 12h) shows some hosts with large mmapped anonymous ranges that never shrink despite GC. suspect mmapped caches used by pinned KV slices; will trace allocation sites next.

Li: if mmapped regions are the culprit, malloc_conf won't help. we should find code paths that use mmap/munmap vs malloc and see if madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) can be used to release pages. I'll add a tracer to record mmap/munmap calls in a canary process.

Theo: nice catch. let's keep both parallel tracks: allocator tuning and mmap tracing. owners recap: Priya (sampler + dashboard) ETA 72h; Omar (restart + eviction) ETA 24h/5d; Li (allocator matrix + mmap tracing) ETA 7d; Theo will own the sync and verification. Sync in 4 days to review sampled deltas, canary restart effects, and the malloc_conf matrix results.

Omar: opening PR for restart orchestration now; will link and tag for review.

Priya: uploading initial smaps + jemalloc dumps to INF-2102. adding a short note on per-shard delta.

Theo: thanks everyone  mark the INF ticket with PR links and set blockers if anything looks risky. we'll close the postmortem loop once we have concrete regression tests and a verified mitigation path. :white_check_mark:
